messages:
maria: Quick request  we need a compact artboard sprint for launch comms: three micro-tiles (latency / cost / quality), 16:9 explainer slide, email header, and a tiny signup flow SVG. Mobile-first. Deadline: Thu EOD.
oliver: Understood. Want reused charts or new visuals?
maria: New visuals but keep the same sparkline language. Emphasize p95.
kevin: I'll create Figma file and include tokens + export presets. Any color rules?
maria: Use brand navy with an accent gold for deltas. Must pass AA for 12px.
legal: Reminder  no absolute superlatives. Use qualifying language and include methodology link in slide footer.
l10n: For FR/JA provide a CSV of source strings and context notes; CTAs max 20 chars.
design-bot: Task created: FIGMA-2100 "artboard-sprint". Assigned: @kevin, @oliver. Due 2025-06-05. Exports: PNG 600x600, PNG 600x200, 1920x1080 slide, SVG icon set, GIF ~2s.
kevin: Uploading starter: https://figma.com/file/artboard-sprint-2100. Will post first pass Wed morning.
maria: Great  include alt text and short accessibility descriptions. Ping here when uploaded for a short review slot.
